user.title: Connect Tuliprox
user.description: Use a Tuliprox WebUI account, not your Home Assistant login or IPTV player login. It must be allowed to read server status and active streams. Prefer a dedicated read-only account; administrator access is broader than needed. Optional Xtream credentials enable account and content sensors.

data_description.url: Base URL reachable from Home Assistant, including http:// or https:// and the port, e.g. http://192.168.1.100:8901. Include a configured WebUI base path, but not /login, /api/v1 or /player_api.php. Use HTTPS on untrusted networks.
data_description.username: Username used to sign in to Tuliprox WebUI. Allow read access to /api/v1/status and /api/v1/streams (system.read in versions with RBAC). No configuration-write or user-management access is needed.
data_description.password: Password for this Tuliprox WebUI account. This is not your Home Assistant password, a JWT token or your IPTV player password.
data_description.xtream_username: Optional, separate Tuliprox player account, as used in TiviMate or IPTV Smarters. Both Xtream fields are needed. Counts reflect the content available to this account.
data_description.xtream_password: Password for the Xtream player account above, not the WebUI account. Leave both Xtream fields empty during initial setup if only status and active streams are needed.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure Tuliprox
reconfigure.description: Update the server URL or WebUI login without removing the integration. Enter the WebUI password again. The account needs read access to server status and active streams; configuration-write access is not needed.

data_description.url: Base URL including protocol and port, e.g. http://192.168.1.100:8901. Include any WebUI base path, but not /login, /api/v1 or /player_api.php. Use HTTPS on untrusted networks.
data_description.username: Tuliprox WebUI account with read access to status and streams (system.read in versions with RBAC), not a Home Assistant or IPTV player account.
data_description.password: Enter the current WebUI password again. The stored password is never shown in this form.
data_description.xtream_username: Separate player account for account status and content counts. This is not the WebUI username.
data_description.xtream_password: When changing Xtream login, enter both the player username and its password. This is separate from the WebUI password.

reauth_confirm.title: Authenticate Tuliprox again
reauth_confirm.description: WebUI authentication was rejected. Enter the current Tuliprox WebUI login. The account must be allowed to read server status and active streams. Xtream player credentials are separate.

data_description.url: Tuliprox base URL including protocol and port, e.g. http://192.168.1.100:8901. Do not append /login, /api/v1 or /player_api.php.
data_description.username: Tuliprox WebUI account with read access to status and streams (system.read in versions with RBAC). Prefer a dedicated read-only account.
data_description.password: Current password for that WebUI account, not a Home Assistant password or JWT token.
data_description.xtream_username: Optional, separate IPTV player account used for account and content sensors.
data_description.xtream_password: When changing Xtream login, enter both player credentials. The WebUI password does not replace the Xtream password.

error.invalid_input: Enter an HTTP(S) URL without embedded credentials, query parameters or fragments, and a nonempty username and password.
error.cannot_connect: Cannot retrieve valid status and stream responses from the server.
error.invalid_xtream_auth: Xtream authentication was rejected. Xtream credentials have been removed.

abort.already_configured: This server URL is already configured.

init.title: Tuliprox options
init.description: Poll every 10-3600 seconds. Enter up to 20 exact, case-sensitive usernames separated by commas. Leave empty to disable user tracking.

error.invalid_users: Enter up to 20 plain usernames, each at most 64 characters, without URLs or credential-like values.
